newsitem.title: USA: TeleSpectrum says will expand call capacity.
newsitem.headline: TeleSpectrum says will expand call capacity.

text.p: TeleSpectrum Worldwide Inc said Wednesday it plans a 30 percent expansion in its calling capacity by June 30.
The company said it will open a new 240-seat call center in Endicott, New York, and will also expand operations by 590 seats at facilities in Arizona, Pennsylvania and Maryland.
In its press release, TeleSpectrum did not provide information on how much money it is investing in the project. A spokesman was not immediately available to comment.
